text: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away.

OVERDOSAGE Drowsiness is the usual clinical side effect. Convulsions, coma, and respiratory depression may occur with massive overdosage. No specific antidote is known. If respiratory depression occurs, mechanically assisted respiration should be initiated and oxygen should be administered. Convulsions should be treated with appropriate doses of diazepam. Phenobarbital (5 to 6 mg/kg) may be given to control convulsions in pediatric patients. The oral LD 50 in mice and rats is 203 mg/kg and 1320 mg/kg, respectively. The intraperitoneal LD 50 in mice is 149 mg/kg.
